epoch.marker_rule: T0 is the committed_at timestamp of evidence/V2.7.31_FORWARD_EPOCH_MARKER.json creation commit.
epoch.eligibility_rule: Only observations at or after T0 can be classified as FORWARD_OBSERVED.
epoch.baseline_rule: Frozen pre-T0 artifacts may be BASELINE_ADOPTED_AT_T0 and used only for decisions strictly after T0.

bootstrap_algorithm: capture current SSE/SZSE official A-share membership after T0
compare current membership to frozen 2026-09-17 baseline set
for current IDs present in baseline: adopt frozen issuer+locator records at T0 without rewriting original observation timestamps
for current IDs absent from baseline: resolve issuer identity from current official exchange evidence and resolve Primary Locator from CNInfo after T0
for baseline IDs absent from current membership: exclude from forward universe
require exactly one issuer identity and one terminal Primary Locator for every current member
freeze Forward Certified Universe snapshot with observed_at/adopted_at provenance
certified_universe_entry_requires: provenance state is BASELINE_ADOPTED_AT_T0 or FORWARD_OBSERVED_AFTER_T0
certified_universe_entry_does_not_requir: full-market re-query of historical CNInfo catalog

downstream.filing_content_use: requires V2.7.30 materialization for the consumed security
downstream.vendor_or_price_coverage: separate per-security execution prerequisite; cannot rewrite Certified Universe membership
downstream.first60: may start only after Forward Certified Universe snapshot PASS
